review:
The revamped Aztec Magic with better graphics, but the same easy-going game underneath: 5x3, 15 lines, a warrior wild and a sorceress scatter. Three scatters anywhere give 10 free spins, which can retrigger, and there's a card gamble after wins if you want it.

What makes it special is how gentle it is. It's rated low volatility, and free spins come round roughly once every 70 spins on average – way more often than most modern games. 96.96% RTP and a 5,000x cap. A great one for long, calm demo sessions or if you're new to slots.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 70 spins on average)
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
